title: Concept: Dependency pinned with build metadata
description: package.json declares a version carrying `+build` metadata, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Build metadata is ignored by precedence but not by every resolver, so two tools can disagree about which artifact the pin names.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package.json (npm).
risk: Build metadata is ignored by precedence but not by every resolver, so two tools can disagree about which artifact the pin names.
